## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(rfPermute)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)


sym_chla <- read.csv("Data/Nov_2024/oculina_nov24_physio.csv")
```

You can add options to executable code like this

re-creating Ella's scatter plot

```{r}
sym_chla_scatter <- ggplot(sym_chla, aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, fill = depth_sa)) +
  geom_point(color='black', shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white","lightyellow","brown"))+

  geom_smooth(aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, group = 1),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Symbiont density (cells per cm2)", 
       y = "Chlorophyll a (ug per cm2)", 
       fill = "Fragment symbiotic state")
sym_chla_scatter


#ug_chla_cm = micrograms of chlorophyll a per cm2 of surface area
#sym_cm2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

removing outliers from above scatter plot, including \[r-val?\]

```{r}

sym_chla_no_out <- sym_chla |>
  filter(sample_ID != "S26-S" & sample_ID != "S15-S")

sym_chla_scatter_no_out <- ggplot(sym_chla_no_out, aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, fill = depth_sa)) +
  geom_point(color='black', shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white","lightyellow","brown"))+

  geom_smooth(aes(x = sym_cm2, y = ug_chla_cm, group = 1),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Symbiont density (cells per cm2)", 
       y = "Chlorophyll a (ug per cm2)", 
       fill = "Fragment symbiotic state")
sym_chla_scatter_no_out
```
